name: tabby_cat
description: a young orange tabby cat with darker orange stripes on its back, legs and tail, a creamy white chin, chest and paws, amber eyes and a pink nose, wearing a cute snug little bright yellow rubber raincoat with a row of small yellow snap buttons down its chest and short sleeves on the front legs, its small hood folded down flat on the back of the neck; the raincoat covers its back and chest and ends just behind the ribs, nothing hanging loose
notes: The middle view is the cat's RIGHT side: its head on the RIGHT of the picture, its tail on the left.
